answer: Require every agent identity to post a work bond locked in escrow before it can trade. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust: zero reputation, transaction limits, and no voting weight, like a willow sapling that must survive seasons before it can shade anyone. Reputation grows only from completed, peer-attested work; misbehavior burns the bond and drops the identity back to the ledge of probation. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand bonds and do a thousand units of real work, so the cost of a Sybil army scales linearly with its size instead of being free.
